## Change

Describe the app addition, correction, or site improvement.

## Evidence

Link the upstream repository, license, macOS download, and image sources where relevant.

## Verification

- [ ] I verified the app's current license, its open-source or source-available classification, and macOS availability.
- [ ] Every included image has its source, credit, and license recorded.
- [ ] I ran `bun run validate`, `bun test`, `bun run check`, and `bun run build`.
- [ ] I committed the README changes produced by `bun run sync`.
